answer:
You should use **`VectorStoreIndex`**, which the docs show being built from your documents with `from_documents`. The module guide says: "The simplest way to use a Vector Store is to load a set of documents and build an index from them using `from_documents`:" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/indexing/vector_store_index.md]

The indexing guide gives the import and the call: "from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex" and "index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/rag/indexing/index.md]

The docs don't say which one fits your project best, so if you need a specific vector store backend, check the storage docs for how to pass it in through a `StorageContext`.
